expect.title: The quiet return of reading later — Example
expect.markdown:
A saved article waits quietly until there is time for it. When it opens on the train, the words are already on the phone, clean and easy to read. (1)

Nothing about the page needs the network once it has been saved. The text sits encrypted on the phone and on two servers that are not ours, so it outlives any one of them. (2)

Reading aloud uses the voice the phone already has. It starts at once, keeps going with the screen locked, and lights each word as it is spoken. (3)

The cover on each save is drawn from its address, so it looks the same on every device, today and after a restore on a new phone. (4)

There is no feed to scroll and nothing to follow. A shelf holds what its owner chose to keep, and it stays theirs if they leave. (5)

A saved article waits quietly until there is time for it. When it opens on the train, the words are already on the phone, clean and easy to read. (6)
